scenes.title: Sign in with Seeker
sentences: Losing a bag should not mean losing the way to get it back. This is Seeker Tag on a real Solana Seeker.
I continue with Seeker, select my wallet, and approve Sign In With Solana in Seed Vault.
My wallet is my identity. Here are my items.

scenes.title: Create a tag and reserve a reward
sentences: I add Travel Backpack and keep Backpack as its category.
A private note describes the bag, so I can recognize it.
The public message explains how to arrange a return, without exposing my phone number.
I add one S K R in test tokens.
And reserve it for seven days.
Before signing, I review the devnet network, depositing wallet, network fee, and account creation cost.
I approve the deposit in Seed Vault. After network confirmation, the reward is reserved on chain.

scenes.title: QR, printable PDF and NFC
sentences: Here is the unique Q R code for this backpack.
I download and open its P D F: six printable formats, with actual sizes and a scale check.
The same link can be written to an N F C tag. This screen is ready for a physical tag.
If my bag goes missing, I mark the item as lost.

scenes.title: Two people. One private conversation.
sentences: On a separate Android session, Alex opens that same tag. The reserved reward is visible.
No account is required. Alex enters a name and a message, then notifies the owner.
The notification arrives on my Seeker and opens our conversation.
I reply from the Seeker, and Alex receives my message in the second session.
We arrange the return inside the app, keeping personal contact details private.

scenes.title: Confirm the recipient and release the reward
sentences: To receive the reward, Alex opens Set receiving wallet directly from the conversation.
Alex enters a Solana address. Connecting a wallet is optional.
After reviewing the address, Alex confirms it.
Back on the Seeker, I choose Finish return directly in our conversation.
I review the payout: the finder gets zero point nine five S K R, after the five percent service fee.
After confirming the simulated handover, I sign the payout with the owner wallet.

scenes.title: Return confirmed. Reward released.
sentences: The transaction is confirmed on Solana devnet. The reward is released, and both conversations show the completed return.
One tag, private coordination, and a verifiable reward. That is Seeker Tag.
